sources.text: Biosfärområde Vänerskärgården med Kinnekulle Hit enter to search or ESC to close Search Close Search Lake Vänern Archipelago and Mount Kinnekulle UNESCO Biosphere Reserve Welcome to Lake Vänern Archipelago and Mount Kinnekulle UNESCO Biosphere Reserve in western Sweden Where people and nature shape the future together The biosphere area is a living landscape where people live and work, businesses develop and communities grow. Lake Vänern, its archipelago and Mount Kinnekulle are home to valuable natural and cultural environments, but also to everyday life and local development. A UNESCO Biosphere Reserve is not a nature reserve. It is a place where people can work together to find ways of caring for nature and cultural heritage while also developing a sustainable society. Discover UNESCO's Man and the Biosphere Programme Bringing people together Much of our work is about bringing different people and organisations together. We work with municipalities, researchers, businesses, associations, organisations, landowners and residents. Sometimes our role is to inspire, sometimes to connect people who can benefit from working together, and sometimes to lead a process from an idea to something that can be put into practice. Our ambition is to help local sustainability initiatives grow and contribute to the UN Sustainable Development Goals. Ideas that grow One example is our Biosphere Ambassador concept. The idea was developed here to give people an opportunity to learn more about the biosphere area and become ambassadors for sustainable development. The concept has since been taken up and further developed by other biosphere reserves in Sweden and in other countries. Starting with children We also work with the youngest people who live here. Through our Mini Ambassadors initiative, children aged 5–6 learn about their local biosphere area, nature and sustainability together with their teachers. More than 500 children have so far become Mini Ambassadors. Working with businesses Local businesses are an important part of the biosphere area and of the work towards a more sustainable society. We work actively with businesses and create opportunities for them to meet, share experiences and develop sustainability initiatives together. For us, this is an important part of the biosphere area’s role: creating connections between people and organisations that might not otherwise meet. DISCOVER THE BIOSPHERE AREA The biosphere area is also a place to visit and experience. Explore Lake Vänern and its islands, discover the landscape and geology of Mount Kinnekulle, walk the Biosphere Trail, experience local food and culture, or simply spend time in the landscape. Learn more about Lake Vänern Archipelago and Mount Kinnekulle. Read more Explore the Biosphere Trail – hiking in a unique natural environment Download brochure Read The Guardian article Our Biosphere reserve The Lake Vänern Archipelago and Mount Kinnekulle UNESCO Biosphere Reserve includes the three municipalities of Lidköping , Götene and Mariestad .
